leadText:
Travon (Japanese: トクゾー Tokuzō) is a character of the day who appeared in The Light of Floccesy Ranch!. He is Ellie's grandfather, and he helps her while working at Floccesy Ranch.

When he met with and , Travon allowed them to stay over since they were Trainers. When the in the farm went missing due to 's machine, he did not trust Ampharos being an efficient guard Pokémon anymore. However, Travon changed his mind once Ampharos mastered . At the end of the episode, he and Ellie said goodbye to Ash and the others.
